title: 2D&3D Production Designer
jobDescription: Designer (3D & 2D Production Artwork) Function Design / Production Artwork Location Remote — India Works with Sales Coordinators, Production team Working hours Aligned to UAE business hours ROLE OVERVIEW The Designer produces the production-ready files that our factory works from. Working from briefs passed on by the sales coordinators, they create both 3D models and 2D vector artwork, then prepare and release clean, accurate production files to the factory floor. After training on our products, materials and file standards, they are expected to produce these files quickly and accurately so production can begin without delay. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • 3D design — create 3D models of awards, trophies and gift items using 3D design software. • 2D artwork — produce 2D vector artwork in Corel DRAW (logos, engraving artwork, print layouts and similar). • Production files — prepare complete, production-ready files that the factory can manufacture from directly. • Speed with accuracy — once trained, turn production files around quickly while keeping them accurate and error-free. • Release to production — release finished files to the production team so work can start without back-and-forth. SKILLS & EXPERIENCE • Solid working knowledge of 3D design software (e.g. Rhino, 3ds Max, Blender, Solid Works or similar). • Strong 2D vector artwork skills in Corel DRAW. • Experience preparing files for manufacturing, engraving, printing or CNC is a strong advantage. • Able to read and work from a design brief and ask the right questions when something is unclear. ATTRIBUTES WE ARE LOOKING FOR • Fast and accurate — able to maintain quality while working at speed. • Detail-oriented, especially with dimensions, artwork and file setup. • Open to training and able to apply our file standards consistently. • Dependable in meeting deadlines. Requirements ​1-3 years of experience in working with 3D & 2D tools

title: Administrative Assistant
jobDescription:
ROLE OVERVIEW: Administrative Assistants provide reliable back-office support across the business. They handle day-to-day administrative tasks, stay well organised, and see their work through to completion. We are looking for people who take ownership of what they are given and follow up properly rather than letting things sit. KEY

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Carry out general administrative tasks accurately and on time. • Keep records, files and trackers organised and up to date. • Take ownership of assigned tasks and follow them through to completion. • Follow up consistently to make sure things get done. • Support the wider team with ad-hoc coordination and data entry as needed. SKILLS & EXPERIENCE: • Prior administrative or office-support experience. • Comfortable with everyday office tools (email, spreadsheets, documents). • Good written and spoken English. ATTRIBUTES WE ARE LOOKING FOR: • Well organised and methodical. • Takes ownership and completes tasks without needing to be chased. • Strong, proactive follow-up. • Reliable and detail-conscious. Requirements Data Entry,MS Office,Excel,Coordination,Record Management, Administrative Assistant

title: Complains Specialist
jobDescription: Manage and maintain product compliance documentation to support global regulatory and customer requirements. Support site-specific product compliance initiatives by ensuring adherence to facility-, customer-, and region-specific regulatory, quality, and environmental requirements, and coordinate with cross-functional teams to maintain ongoing compliance. Ensure compliance with international product regulations and environmental directives, including REACH, Ro HS, TSCA, PFAS, Proposition 65, and other applicable global requirements. Coordinate with Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Suppliers, and Customers to obtain and validate compliance data. Review supplier documentation for completeness and regulatory compliance and follow up on outstanding requests. Support IMDS submissions and maintain accurate material data records to meet customer and regulatory requirements. Monitor changes to global product compliance regulations and assist in implementing updated compliance requirements. Investigate and resolve compliance-related issues, documentation discrepancies, and customer inquiries. We are looking to hire a candidate with 3 to 4 years of experience who has completed an Engineering degree, preferably with a background in the Manufacturing industry. Requirements Compliance, Documentation, Product regulation

title: Logistics & Shipping Cordinator
jobDescription: Logistics & Shipping Coordinator Function Logistics / Shipping Location Remote — India Works with Sales Coordinators, Shipping vendors, Production Working hours Aligned to UAE business hours ROLE OVERVIEW The Logistics & Shipping Coordinator manages the shipping side of our orders remotely. They source shipping rates from vendors, prepare the necessary shipping documentation, and follow shipments closely from dispatch to delivery. A clear understanding of UAE shipping requirements is important, and the role calls for someone genuinely attentive who stays on top of every shipment. title: Product Specialist
jobDescription:
Job

ROLE:
Product Specialist – Product Management Support Company Overview Vserve Ebusiness Solutions is a leading ISO 27001:2013 certified provider of e-commerce solutions and product catalog management services. We offer comprehensive industry- specific solutions and strive to help enterprises transform and grow in the ever-changing world of technology. Our customer-centric approach ensures sustainable solutions and strategies tailored to meet client requirements. Job Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Product Specialist to support Product Management initiatives related to product development, vendor coordination, market research, and product lifecycle management. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical and organizational skills, along with the ability to coordinate cross-functional activities, manage product-related data, and support go-to-market readiness activities. This role will play a key part in evaluating market opportunities, supporting product launches, and maintaining accurate product information across systems and stakeholders. Responsibilities • Assist Product Specialist in the development, implementation, and management of product programs and initiatives. • Interact with vendors and suppliers to optimize supplier relationships and support product-related activities. • Conduct market research to analyze market pricing, customer buying behavior, annual unit potential, and competitive landscape. • Evaluate competitor product offerings to identify product differentiation, market gaps, and growth opportunities. • Assess vendor and fulfillment options, including stocked and drop-ship programs, while identifying suitable supplier opportunities. • Analyze product cost structures, margins, minimum order quantities (MOQs), and lead time to support business decision-making. • Summarize research findings and present insights into Product Management for review and evaluation. • Partner with Product Management teams to support approved products through the pre-launch process, including inventory tracking and launch coordination. • Manage new item setup activities by collecting, validating, and submitting vendor and product-related information for internal system processing. • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure accurate product setup and maintenance within organizational systems. • Gather and organize vendor-provided product marketing content, including product descriptions, specifications, and images to support go-to-market readiness. • Monitor and analyze category and new item performance using Business Intelligence (BI) tools, including sales trends, inventory performance, and category- level reporting. • Maintain, update, and improve product data accuracy throughout the product lifecycle by coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. • Attend and actively participate in internal meetings, product reviews, training sessions, and cross-functional discussions. • Promptly escalate concerns, discrepancies, or process-related issues to the leadership team when necessary. • Maintain consistent productivity, quality standards, and adherence to organizational KPIs and timelines. Qualifications and Skills • Strong understanding of market research, competitor analysis, and customer buying behavior. • Excellent organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and timelines effectively. • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail. • Basic understanding of product costing, margins, inventory concepts, and supply chain processes. • Experience in vendor coordination, product management support, or related operational functions is preferred. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly advanced Microsoft Excel functions such as Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and reporting tools. • Ability to utilize Business Intelligence (BI) tools for sales, inventory, and category analysis. • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate professionally with vendors and internal stakeholders. • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. • High level of reliability, accuracy, and integrity while handling business-critical product and vendor information. • Adaptability to evolving business processes and willingness to learn new systems, tools, and technologies. Education and Certification Basic Degree – Experience or educational background related to Product Management, Supply Chain Management, Marketing, Business Administration, or related fields is an added advantage. Team and Reporting Night Shift: 6:00 PM to 3:00 AM / 08:00 PM to 05:00 AM (IST) – After Daylight Saving Night Shift: 07:00 PM to 04:00 AM / 09:00 PM to 06:00 AM (IST) – During Daylight Saving Week Off: Saturday and Sunday Location Coimbatore, India Work from Office. Requirements Market Analysis or Maket Research, competitive analysis, SAP, Power Bi,Microsoft Office , SCM , Procrument, Demand forcasting, and Spend analysis

title: Quality Controller
jobDescription: Job Title: Quality Control Manager – IT/ITES/BPO Location: Coimbatore/ Anywhere in South India Experience: 12+ Years Department : Quality / Operations Excellence Job Description: Quality Control Manager (IT / ITES / BPO) Title : Quality Control Manager — IT / ITES / BPO Location : (WFO / Remote/ Hybrid) – Need to confirm Experience : 10+ years (with 4–6+ years in people/quality leadership) Department : Quality / Operations Excellence Job Summary Lead the quality function across IT / ITES / BPO delivery — design and run the Quality Management System (QMS), own quality KPIs, lead audits, drive process improvements (RCA & CAPA), and embed analytics and automation into QA. You will manage a team of Quality Analysts / QA Leads, partner with Ops/Training/Clients, and drive measurable improvements in customer experience and compliance. Key Responsibilities ∙ Own design, implementation and governance of the QMS (policies, scorecards, calibration, audit cadence). ∙ Lead, coach and scale quality teams across projects/centers (hiring, capacity planning, performance management). ∙ Define, monitor and report on quality KPIs & SLAs (CSAT, QA score, error rate, AHT impact, compliance). ∙ Conduct audits, root-cause analyses and implement CAPAs; reduce rework and defects. ∙ Drive process improvement initiatives: Lean / Six Sigma projects, automation of QA checks, AI-assisted monitoring. ∙ Implement calibration sessions, standard evaluation rubrics and quality knowledge base. ∙ Build dashboards and self-service reports (Power BI / Tableau / Excel macros) to deliver real-time insights. ∙ Collaborate with Training, Ops and Client stakeholders to close gaps and roll out improvement plans. ∙ Manage vendor/client quality governance and prepare materials for external audits/certifications. ∙ Lead initiatives to improve employee engagement and quality culture. Required Skills & Competencies ∙ Strong knowledge of QA frameworks and standards: COPC, ISO ∙ Advanced analytics skills — Excel, SQL, Power BI / Tableau for root-cause & trend analysis. ∙ Experience with QA automation / speech/text analytics tools and AI-enabled monitoring (desirable). ∙ Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — client-facing experience required. ∙ Proven track record in building & leading high-performing QA teams and change programs. ∙ Strong problem solving — RCA, corrective action planning, process documentation. Qualifications ∙ Any bachelor’s degree ∙ Minimum 12 years in Quality/Operations in IT / ITES / BPO with 4–6 years in managerial/leadership roles. Requirements Quality Manager, Root cause analysis,BPO/IT/ITES, CAPA ​

title: Sales Coordinator
jobDescription: ROLE OVERVIEW The Sales Coordinator is the central point of coordination between our salespeople, the design team, the factory and external suppliers. They own every order from the moment a request comes in until it is fully handed over to production and the salesperson has what they need. This is not a messenger or pure communication role — the coordinator is expected to take full responsibility for each task, drive it forward, follow up relentlessly, and make sure every detail is correct and nothing falls through the cracks. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Design requests — raise design requests on behalf of the salesperson and make sure the requirements are communicated to the designer clearly and completely. • Follow-up on design — track each design request, follow up with the designer, and ensure the design is completed correctly and on time. • Returning designs — share the completed design back with the salesperson and manage the feedback loop. • Revisions — handle the full revision cycle the same way: communicate changes clearly, follow up, and confirm the updated design is delivered on time. • Job orders — create accurate job orders on our ERP system once a design and order are confirmed. • Production briefing — inform production of all specific details and requirements for each job so it can be made correctly. • Supplier / outsourcing liaison — when a project needs something specific from an outside supplier, contact them, follow up, and make sure we get exactly what is required. • Pricing support — price items for the salesperson using our internal costing tools so they can quote their clients. • Delivery & logistics — coordinate delivery and logistics so orders reach clients on time. • Records — maintain accurate, up-to-date records across every order and interaction. • Smooth communication — keep communication flowing perfectly and smoothly between all channels — sales, design, production, suppliers and logistics. SKILLS & EXPERIENCE • Prior experience in sales coordination, order processing, customer service or a similar back-office operations role. • Comfortable working with an ERP or order-management system (training on our system will be provided). • Excellent written and spoken English. • Strong with numbers and able to follow a structured pricing process accurately. ATTRIBUTES WE ARE LOOKING FOR • Highly organised, with the ability to juggle many orders at once without dropping details. • Takes genuine ownership — treats every order as their responsibility until it is done. • Proactive follow-up: chases tasks to completion rather than waiting. • Meticulous attention to detail. • Reliable, accountable and calm under pressure. Requirements Sales Coordinator, Order Management, Customer suppoet, ERP, Logistics Coordination
